items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: Yeah, Marino owned his hotel. He's still there. He's still here, incidentally.

ctx.x: And he owned the hotel hotel?

Yeah, Marino owned his hotel. He's still there. He's still here, incidentally. Well anyway, Freddie King and I got to talking. We got friendly. And I told him about my tune. He didn't bring me a record. So he brought, he came to my house, listened to it. He said, I'm going to take this record back to Dallas. And he took the record back to Dallas with him. And lo and behold, Freddie King recorded my tune as an instrumental. And the title was San Jose. And if you listen to the two tunes they are exactly, he played…
Did Freddie stay here for a long period of time?
